name: Beto Carrero World
desc: Large theme park in Penha, Santa Catarina, Brazil, with licensed Hot Wheels, Nerf and DreamWorks themed areas.

signals.what: Hot Wheels Turbo Drive attraction opened
Fort Alamo demolished for new Galinha Pintadinha attraction

fit_rationale: Domestic Brazilian theme park with licensed brand partnerships; Sao Paulo Grand Prix gives a Brazil link, but no visitor or revenue figures were found to show scale.

name: KM Malta Airlines
desc: Government-owned Maltese flag carrier launched 2024 operating eight Airbus A320neo aircraft from Malta to about 20 European cities.
markets: Malta to Europe and Tel Aviv

signals.what: Announced summer 2026 routes to Palermo and Malaga

fit_rationale: Small state flag carrier with eight aircraft; tourism promotion for Malta is possible but no revenue, funding amount or state commercial mandate figure was found.

name: Palace Skateboards
desc: London streetwear and skateboard brand with flagship stores in London, New York, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul and Hong Kong.
markets: UK, US, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong
fit_rationale: Hype streetwear label known for brand collaborations (Adidas, Nike, Ralph Lauren); a team-apparel capsule fits F1's fashion push, but revenue is unpublished and scale unproven.

name: LEVEL (Fly Level SL)
desc: Spanish long-haul low-cost airline of IAG, majority held by Iberia since 2025, flying six Airbus A330-200s from Barcelona.

signals.what: Received own Air Operator's Certificate and IATA code LL
IAG allocated A330-900 orders to Level

fit_rationale: Small IAG long-haul low-cost brand with six aircraft; separate company since its 2024 AOC, but no revenue published and marketing likely set within IAG/Iberia.

name: Unity Line
desc: Polish ferry operator running ro-ro and rail ferries between Swinoujscie and Ystad and Trelleborg in Sweden.
fit_rationale: Two-route Baltic freight and passenger ferry operator; no revenue found and no business reason to buy global motorsport rights.

name: Empact Group
desc: South African Level 1 B-BBEE facilities group providing contract catering, cleaning and hygiene (Supercare) and facilities management in Southern Africa.
customers: corporate, industrial, healthcare, education, mining, retail clients
fit_rationale: Southern African contract catering and cleaning firm; no reported revenue found (Clay bracket only) and no Grand Prix market overlap.

name: Thebe Investment Corporation
desc: Johannesburg black-owned investment holding founded in 1992 with energy and resources and services divisions.
fit_rationale: Investment holding company with unnamed portfolio and no published assets or revenue; little consumer or motorsport relevance.
outstanding: portfolio, assets, ownership (Batho Batho Trust at founding)

name: Solo Resource Recovery
desc: Australian-owned waste collection and recycling company serving councils, businesses and households in Queensland, NSW, Perth, Melbourne and Adelaide.
fit_rationale: Regional Australian waste contractor; no revenue found and no business case beyond Melbourne GP locality.

name: Meica
desc: Family-owned German sausage and convenience food maker behind Curry King, Bratmaxe, Deutschländer and Mini Wini brands.
fit_rationale: Well-known German sausage brands but only EUR 96m revenue (2016) and domestic sales; no recent figures to meet a route.

name: Lüftner Cruises
desc: Family-owned Austrian river-cruise operator running the 16-ship Amadeus fleet on European rivers.

signals.what: Amadeus Aurea river ship due in service; Amadeus Mira planned 2027

fit_rationale: Family river-cruise line with 16 ships; premium travel audience, but no revenue found and scale is modest.

name: Parmigiani Fleurier
desc: Swiss haute-horlogerie watchmaker owned by the Sandoz Family Foundation, making a few thousand watches a year.
fit_rationale: Small high-end watchmaker (few thousand pieces a year) with past Bugatti watch collaboration; premium fit but no revenue evidence and crowded watch category.
category_conflict: potential: watch category crowded in F1

name: Mestemacher
desc: Gütersloh bakery founded 1871 making long-life wholegrain and pumpernickel breads exported to more than 50 countries.
fit_rationale: Niche packaged-bread exporter; no revenue or ownership found (Wikipedia infobox says 'Public', unverified), scale appears below route thresholds.

name: Madagascar Airlines
desc: Majority state-owned Malagasy flag carrier flying a small ATR fleet mainly on domestic routes after suspending international services in 2023.
markets: Madagascar domestic and nearby Indian Ocean
profitability_basis: described as a loss-making airline; net losses 2016-2018 (en.wikipedia)
distress: operational disruptions Nov 2024; CEO resigned Oct 2025; needs government support
fit_rationale: Small loss-making state airline in distress with nine aircraft; no capacity or reason to buy F1 rights.

name: MFA Incorporated
desc: Missouri farm supply co-operative owned by more than 45,000 farmer members in Missouri and adjacent states.
fit_rationale: Regional US agricultural supply co-op; no revenue found and no motorsport or international brand rationale.

name: Perrelet
desc: Swiss watch brand known for its Turbine models, owned since 2004 by Barcelona-based Festina Group, producing about 30,000 watches a year.
fit_rationale: Small Festina-owned watch brand (about 30,000 pieces a year); scale too small and watch category crowded.

name: Paul Hewitt
desc: German accessories brand selling watches and jewellery with a nautical, ocean-conservation theme.
fit_rationale: Small fashion-watch label; no ownership, revenue or scale data found.

name: Magellan Jets
desc: Boston-founded asset-light private aviation company selling jet cards, charter and fractional access through vetted operators.
profitability_basis: company states it is 'privately owned, profitable, and carries zero debt'

signals.what: Launched customizable Jet Card with 'Advantage Routes' (guide updated Sep 2026)

fit_rationale: Private-jet card seller whose high-net-worth buyers overlap F1 hospitality guests (US races), but no revenue or scale figure is published.

name: Entrepreneur Media
desc: Owner-run US publisher of Entrepreneur magazine and entrepreneur.com, known for Franchise 500 and Entrepreneur 360 rankings.
fit_rationale: Business-media brand; would be a media partner rather than a sponsor, and Clay's USD 1bn+ bracket and 8,601 employees look implausible for a magazine publisher.
compliance: criticised for aggressive trademark lawsuits over the word 'entrepreneur'

name: Twisted Minds
desc: Saudi esports organisation, main sponsor Riyadh Season, winner of 2025 Esports World Cup PUBG and Warzone titles.
parent_ultimate: Ibrahim Bin Jibreen and Hatem Almukhailed

signals.what: Won PUBG: Battlegrounds and Call of Duty: Warzone at Esports World Cup

fit_rationale: Esports team that is itself a sponsorship seller (Riyadh Season backs it); not a buyer of F1 rights.

name: Bertocchi Smallgoods
desc: Melbourne maker of continental smallgoods sold under Bertocchi, San Marino, Wurstel, Happy Pig and Foremost brands in Australian supermarkets.

fin.value_orig: AUD 198.7m revenue (balance date 6/22; IBISWorld Top 500 Private 2022 rank 358; older than 3 years)

fit_rationale: Domestic smallgoods maker; USD 131m revenue (2022) is in the Route B range but no supporting strength was found.

name: Ausbuild
desc: Queensland home builder and community developer; says more than 30,000 people live in Ausbuild homes.

fin.value_orig: AUD 199.1m revenue (balance date 6/21; IBISWorld Top 500 Private 2022 rank 357; older than 3 years)

fit_rationale: Queensland volume home builder; domestic and USD 131m revenue (2021) with no supporting strength.

name: Selection Steel
desc: Australian supplier of pre-painted and zinc-coated steel (UniCote, UniZinc) with shearing and slitting services.

fin.value_orig: AUD 199.2m revenue (balance date 6/22; IBISWorld Top 500 Private 2022 rank 355; older than 3 years)

fit_rationale: Domestic steel trader; USD 131m revenue (2022) with no supporting strength or brand rationale.

name: Elite Rede de Ensino
subsector: private K-12 schools and exam prep
desc: Brazilian private school and exam-preparation network with units in ten states and the Federal District.
markets: Brazil (10 states incl. Rio de Janeiro, Sao Paulo)
fit_rationale: Domestic Brazilian school network; the Clay USD 1-10bn bracket is implausible and no reported revenue was found.
outstanding: owner (privacy links point to a 'gruposalta' domain), revenue

name: BH Fitness
desc: Spanish fitness equipment brand (Exercycle S.L.) making home and professional machines, sister to BH Bikes.
markets: Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Germany, UK (site languages)
fit_rationale: Mid-size Spanish fitness-equipment brand; no revenue or scale data found.
outstanding: revenue, group structure with BH Bikes

name: Bodytech (Brazil)
desc: Rio de Janeiro gym chain with over 30 years of history offering memberships, kids programmes and franchises.
fit_rationale: Brazilian premium gym brand; no gym count or revenue found (input name is ambiguous with a Colombian Bodytech).
outstanding: which Bodytech the input meant; gym count, revenue

name: Magic Costa Blanca (Magic Hotel Group)
desc: Spanish Costa Blanca hotel chain now branded Magic Hotel Group, the 14th-largest Spanish hotel employer in 2025.
fit_rationale: Regional Spanish resort chain; only one scale indicator (staff) and no international source markets shown.

name: Tundra Esports
desc: London-based esports organisation known for its Dota 2 team, winner of four Tier-1 tournaments in 2025.

signals.what: Won four Tier-1 Dota 2 tournaments incl. ESL One Birmingham 2026

fit_rationale: Esports team that sells sponsorship rather than buys it; main partner is Russian bookmaker Winline.
